The corrected Vantorre Group seat count you posted on 1 Jul is 280 seats. I replied in the thread on your message in #strategic-pod.

You first posted 300 at 09:14. At 09:19 you corrected it to 280, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is active seats on the production roster as of 1 Jul. That's the number from that day, so check it against the current roster if the deck needs today's figure.
